description: From the summit ridge near the observatory, the caldera rim of La Palma stretches out under a blazing starfield — the great volcanic bowl falling away into darkness with the telescope domes silhouetted along the ridge. The Milky Way runs thick overhead in one of the world's finest dark-sky reserves. Roque de los Muchachos is where astronomers come to touch the stars; tonight the sky does the talking.
